title: RULE vs UNDERGROUND
directVerdict: RULE is the better fit for focus, while UNDERGROUND is the better fit for energy.
majorFormulaDifferences: Alpha GPC: RULE 600 mg; UNDERGROUND 300 mg.
Mucuna Pruriens: RULE 100 mg; UNDERGROUND 70 mg.

Only RULE discloses: L-Citrulline: 5 g per 2 scoops; L-Tyrosine: 3 g per 2 scoops; Lion's Mane: 800 mg per 2 scoops; Dendrobium Extract: 300 mg per 2 scoops; Uridine Monophosphate: 250 mg per 2 scoops; Cafe Alatus: 100 mg per 2 scoops; Bitter Orange Extract: 80 mg per 2 scoops; Dicaffeine Malate: 50 mg per 2 scoops.

Only UNDERGROUND discloses: Citrulline Malate: 7 g per full serving; Taurine: 1000 mg per full serving; Dendrobium Extract 10:1: 600 mg per full serving; Sodium Bicarbonate: 500 mg per full serving; N-Acetyl L-Tyrosine: 250 mg per full serving; Choline Bitartrate: 200 mg per full serving; Juniper Berry: 150 mg per full serving; AstraGin: 25 mg per full serving.
RULE caffeine: RULE officially lists 485 mg total caffeine per 2 scoops; 1-scoop option also shown. UNDERGROUND caffeine: UNDERGROUND officially lists 350 mg total caffeine per 1 scoop (17.04 g).
experience: RULE: RULE: A hyper-focus pre-workout positioned around concentrated nootropic support, controlled focus, energy, and performance. The easiest concrete points are 485 mg official total caffeine at two scoops, 3 g L-Tyrosine, Lion's Mane and Uridine. UNDERGROUND: UNDERGROUND: A high-stimulant pre-workout with a broad disclosed focus and performance formula. The easiest concrete points are 350 mg caffeine, 7 g Citrulline Malate, 3.2 g Beta-Alanine.
chooseFirstWhen: Customers prioritizing focus and nootropic ingredients
chooseSecondWhen: Customers seeking 350 mg caffeine and a full pre-workout
tradeoffs: RULE: Stimulant-sensitive shoppers; A daily low-stimulant request
UNDERGROUND: Stimulant-sensitive shoppers; A daily low-stimulant request
bottomLine: Match the recommendation to the buyer’s primary goal: RULE for focus; UNDERGROUND for energy.
